basis: Orthographic captures of the current Three.js model, with a temporary horizontal section 1.15m above PA floor to expose door/window openings. Renderer changes were capture-only. Screen right corresponds to smaller CAD x; screen top to smaller CAD depth.
limitations: AI-generated schematic floor plans, not measured CAD files. Materials, line weights, wall thickness graphics and stair tread details are illustrative. Furniture and wall/opening layout reviewed against model captures. Immutable reference HTML and engine geometry unchanged.
